protocol.purpose: Formative usability and counterplay study; not a population effectiveness trial
protocol.fixedSelection: adaptation-v1; selected on scripted orbit/reverse/cover; strongest fixed comparator in that benchmark
protocol.memory: Fresh independent policy per condition; identical seed, stats, map and controls
protocol.order: Cryptographically randomized 50/50 by default; facilitator may assign balanced order using the URL and assignment is recorded
protocol.concealment: Condition identity and learning inspector hidden until both questionnaires are submitted. Client-side concealment is not tamper-proof.
protocol.prompts: Find a repeatable movement route for six rounds, then deliberately change it for six rounds. Keys never change.
questions: Unaided description of changes and supporting evidence
Did your changed approach work, and what happened?
protocol.analysis: Retain all incomplete sessions and exclusions. Report paired participant ratings, preference counts, unaided descriptions, and combat traces descriptively. No inferential population claim from 6–10 formative participants.
protocol.success: Before expanding scope, seek concrete unaided descriptions linked to observed tactics, deliberate successful counterplay, and acceptable fairness. A difficulty increase or a correct condition guess alone is insufficient.
protocol.limitations: Twelve rounds may not expose adaptation. Human movement is not matched between conditions. Order, practice, expectations and fixed-baseline selection can influence results. Automated QA is excluded from human findings.
